sections.content: Report from dashboard: 7. Automation & Workflows. Generated automatically by DBDOME.

sections.query:
select 
	sr.row_id , s."server" "IP Address" , s.servername ,  r.routine_name metric_rule ,  case when sr.is_active = true then 'Active' else 'Inactive' end as Active , r.db_version as  "db vendor" from metrics.routines r
join metrics.servers_routines sr on sr.routine_id = r.row_id
join metrics.servers s on s.row_id = sr.server_id
order by s.server , metric_rule
